name: hand
description: Lossless session snapshot + restore for Claude Code. /hand:off archives transcript context into a deterministic trimmed brief (recap + status frontmatter), a rebuildable SQLite index, and a task-list bundle; /hand:on restores all three after /clear — including the todo graph with its blockedBy edges intact. Browse, search, archive, and rename sessions with the `hand` CLI or a 2-pane Textual TUI. Explicit, no auto-compaction hooks.
